statusDetail: Quick Sheet now checks key cached roadside routes before signal drops.
actionRequired: No action needed. Review Quick Sheet on iPhone before a trip to confirm the cached-route status feels clear.
summary: Added an iPhone-visible Offline Route Check to the Quick Sheet Print / Offline Pack. The check reports whether Quick Sheet, Diagnostics, Fuses, and Garage Backup routes are available in the browser cache, feeds those results into the copy/share prep note, updates search coverage, and bumps the service-worker cache to v353.
impactReason: Before leaving signal, the iPhone Quick Sheet can now confirm the key cached roadside routes and include that status in the prep handoff.
